description: This file defines a SwiftUI View named CalculatorView along with its ViewModel CalculatorCardViewModel, implementing a simple calculator interface with input handling, arithmetic operations, and result display.

classes.name: CalculatorCardViewModel
classes.description: An ObservableObject managing the calculator's input, result, and operations.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds the parsed input value to the current result.

methods.name: subtract
methods.description: Subtracts the parsed input value from the current result.

methods.name: multiply
methods.description: Multiplies the current result by the parsed input value.

methods.name: divide
methods.description: Divides the current result by the parsed input value, handling division by zero.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Resets the input string and result to their initial states.

methods.name: parseInput
methods.description: Converts the input string to a Double, supporting comma and dot decimal separators.
